insight.description: Insight ID monitored by this alert. Note: Response returns full InsightBasicSerializer object.

subscribed_users.description: User IDs to subscribe to this alert. Note: Response returns full UserBasicSerializer object.

threshold.description: Threshold configuration with bounds and type for evaluating the alert.

condition.description: Alert condition type. Determines how the value is evaluated: absolute_value, relative_increase, or relative_decrease.

state.description: Current alert state: Firing, Not firing, Errored, or Snoozed.

enabled.description: Whether the alert is actively being evaluated.

checks.description: Alert check results. By default returns the last 5. Use checks_date_from and checks_date_to (e.g. '-24h', '-7d') to get checks within a time window, checks_limit to cap how many are returned (default 5, max 500), and checks_offset to skip the newest N checks for pagination (0-based). Newest checks first. Only populated on retrieve.

checks_total.description: Total alert checks matching the retrieve filters (date window). Only set on alert retrieve; omitted otherwise.

config.description: Trends-specific alert configuration. Includes series_index (which series to monitor) and check_ongoing_interval (whether to check the current incomplete interval).

calculation_interval.description:
How often the alert is checked: hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly.

* `hourly` - hourly
* `daily` - daily
* `weekly` - weekly
* `monthly` - monthly

snoozed_until.description: Snooze the alert until this time. Pass a relative date string (e.g. '2h', '1d') or null to unsnooze.

skip_weekend.description: Skip alert evaluation on weekends (Saturday and Sunday, local to project timezone).

schedule_restriction.description: Blocked local time windows (HH:MM in the project timezone). Interval is half-open [start, end): start inclusive, end exclusive. Use blocked_windows array of {start, end}. Null disables.

last_value.description: The last calculated value from the most recent alert check.

investigation_agent_enabled.description: When enabled, an investigation agent runs on the state transition to firing and writes findings to a Notebook linked from the alert check. Only effective for detector-based (anomaly) alerts.

investigation_gates_notifications.description: When enabled (and investigation_agent_enabled is on), notification dispatch is held until the investigation agent produces a verdict. Notifications are suppressed when the verdict is false_positive (and optionally when inconclusive). A safety-net task force-fires after a few minutes if the investigation stalls.

investigation_inconclusive_action.description:
How to handle an 'inconclusive' verdict when notifications are gated. 'notify' is the safe default — an agent that can't be sure is itself useful signal.

* `notify` - Notify
* `suppress` - Suppress
